purpose: Identify which committed local source surfaces can follow one episode from exposure through alternatives, response, meaning/action, recovery, and exit.
stage_summary_rule: Classify a status as observed when it begins with 'observed', partial when it begins with 'partial', and open_or_unknown for all other labels, including reference-period and unknown statuses.

result: No current local source closes all nine required stages. The strict MEPS event-window follow-up now adds a same-person later R5/3 health and employment clock, including health and work persistence transitions, but it still lacks a dated initiating need, usable alternatives, institutional response, remedy, meaning/action, and practical exit. The IER resolution summaries advance the verified-remedy stage with four agency-reported individual payments, while the telephone-intervention ledger adds a tighter reported barrier-to-correction sequence. The new DACA bilateral case adds reported wage restoration, seniority restoration, and complaint withdrawal in one episode; the new OSHA Texas case adds protected safety voice, retaliation, public-risk governance, and an ordered remedy. Neither supplies durable follow-up. The Rehman case adds a bounded no-substitute-paid-earnings observation and an enforceable gross lost-remuneration order. The Mansoor platform case adds same-case substitute earnings alongside reactivation and a lost-pay order, while preserving the unknowns around equivalence, receipt, and durable access. The FWC site-clearance, customer-allocation, Westrip, and Adcon cases supply observed alternative employment, search or transition effort, non-return or shutdown reasoning, reported stress, and bounded income trade-offs; the Greaves case supplies an observed unsuccessful alternative-employment search, and the McGennan appeal adds alternative earnings and client-redirection action. The Meadley follow-up adds an officially reported compensation payment without reinstatement and a court-enforcement action. The Handy record adds a current platform-worker redress distribution while preserving the missing individual cashing, wage restoration, alternative work, and durable bargaining stages. These records show that payment, restoration, worker voice, later health/work persistence, and action are separate endpoints; later household recovery, durable trust, recurrence, and exit remain open. The Honda Talon and VRURC ledgers compare dealer repair with replacement while retaining purchaser-level gaps; the CFPB credit-card ledger makes a monetary-relief response label durable without proving issuance or receipt. The closest route-specific surfaces remain the named CFPB redress/distribution records, Doxo, Grubhub, Handy, the platform remedy ledger, the OpenAI/Statsig and Apple recruitment-remedy events, Hotak continued-work follow-up, and Warraich follow-up for formal response/remedy or implementation, and the MEPS/SHED/HTOPS panels for selected timing or persistence; they are complementary, not joinable into one episode.
next_test: Select one lawful consumer, public-system, household, health, or workplace episode source and add a stable episode key for actor, alternatives, effort, protected/sacrificed outcome, verified remedy, attribution, later trust/action, and exit. The DACA case demonstrates reported bilateral wage/status repair and immediate complaint withdrawal; the OSHA case demonstrates protected safety voice followed by retaliation and an ordered remedy; Meadley demonstrates payment receipt with failed restoration; Adcon adds reported household stress and lower-paid replacement work but no receipt. Promotion still requires a same-episode alternative or non-use field plus a later household recovery, durable trust, recurrence, or exit field.

promotion_gate.rule: A new end-to-end finding may be promoted only when the same retained episode source, or an explicitly linked episode key, observes both an episode-level alternative or non-use outcome and verified remedy receipt or a defined outcome follow-up, with denominators and missingness reported.
promotion_gate.failure_reason: The DACA case supplies a reported accepted bilateral remedy and immediate complaint withdrawal, while the OSHA case supplies protected safety voice, retaliation, and an ordered remedy; neither has later household recovery, durable trust/action, recurrence, or exit. The Meadley case supplies an officially reported compensation payment and failed reinstatement, while the FWC cases, Adcon, and Mansoor platform case supply obtained alternatives, substitute earnings, unsuccessful search, stated non-return, reported household stress, and post-dismissal client action. No retained route combines those stages with later household recovery, durable trust/action, recurrence, or exit. Westrip, Adcon, and Mansoor strengthen the alternative-employment comparators but their compensation remains an order without receipt.

storage_boundary: Uses thirty-four committed local source surfaces; raw parent-product and complaint responses remain outside Git, while compact de-identified filtered ledgers and bounded case records are retained. No prevalence estimate is promoted.
